big_case.notes: Solicitor General stay of an injunction halting border-barrier construction in the Big Bend Sector. The per curiam announced a categorical proposition ('There is no such thing as a "constitutional" major-questions claim') that reaches beyond IIRIRA's review scheme, but it came on the interim docket, over one noted dissent, in a narrow statutory-review setting. Nationally salient and doctrinally notable, not a landmark.

leakage.notes: Forward cell. Prediction made 2026-10-23; the stay was granted 2026-11-09. No retrieved_doc_date on or after resolution and no query for this application's disposition. Its retrieval covered Dalton v. Specter, Trump v. Sierra Club and earlier waiver litigation only. Its one qp-topics mention is an rg exclusion glob, which is not a read.

central_claims.basis: The Nov 9 order grants the application and stays the injunction pending the filing and disposition of a cert petition.
central_claims.claim: The full Court will grant an unqualified stay of the preliminary injunction pending a timely cert petition, not a partial or administrative stay.

central_claims.basis: The per curiam says the claim alleges the Secretary exceeded statutory authority (Dalton) and that there is no such thing as a 'constitutional' major-questions claim.
central_claims.claim: If explained, the principal ground is that the major-questions challenge attacks statutory authority and is outside §102(c)(2)(A)'s constitutional-claims-only review.

central_claims.basis: The Court granted 'the requested stay' and did not summarily reverse.
central_claims.claim: A stay is more likely than adopting the request for summary reversal.

central_claims.basis: The per curiam relies on the CBP declaration of nearly half a million dollars a day in unrecoverable costs.
central_claims.claim: The concrete costs of halted construction will support the stay.

central_claims.basis: Referral (Nov 9) and one amicus brief (Oct 29) are borne out. The disposition came Nov 9, after the forecast window, so the timing claim missed.
central_claims.claim: Referral to the full Court and at least one amicus entry; disposition between Oct 30 and Nov 6.
